ConvertHybridInstance.description_en: Converts a subscription instance to a hybrid billing instance
ConvertHybridInstance.description_zh: 调用本API可将现在包年包月的实例变更为混合计费的实例

ConvertInstance.description_en: Converts a pay-as-you-go workspace to a subscription workspace
ConvertInstance.description_zh: 您可以将按量付费的工作空间转换为包年包月的工作空间

ConvertPrepayInstance.description_en: Converts a subscription instance to pay-as-you-go
ConvertPrepayInstance.description_zh: 调用本API可将您包年包月的实例转化为按量付费

CreateInstance.description_en: Creates a subscription or pay-as-you-go fully managed Flink workspace
CreateInstance.description_zh: 创建一个包年包月或者按量付费flink全托管工作空间

CreateNamespace.description_en: Creates a workspace in a fully managed Flink instance
CreateNamespace.description_zh: 在flink全托管实例中下创建项目空间

DeleteInstance.description_en: Releases a pay-as-you-go Realtime Compute for Apache Flink workspace
DeleteInstance.description_zh: 释放按量付费的flink全托管工作空间

DescribeInstances.description_en: Queries the details of one or more fully managed Flink workspaces
DescribeInstances.description_zh: 查询一个或多个flink全托管工作空间的详细信息

DescribeNamespaces.description_en: Queries the namespace information of a specified instance
DescribeNamespaces.description_zh: 您可以调用DescribeNamespaces查询某实例下的项目空间信息

DescribeSupportedRegions.description_en: Retrieves information about regions that support purchases of fully managed Flink
DescribeSupportedRegions.description_zh: 您可以获取支持购买的地域信息

DescribeSupportedZones.description_en: Retrieves information about zones that are available for purchase
DescribeSupportedZones.description_zh: 您可以获取支持购买的可用区信息

GetFlinkAiService.description_en: Retrieves the status of the Flink AI service

GetFlinkAiServiceFreeQuota.description_en: Retrieves the free quota usage of Flink AI services
GetFlinkAiServiceFreeQuota.description_zh: 获取Flink AI服务免费额度使用情况

ListTagResources.description_en: Queries resource tags. You can query tag keys by tag values, query tag values by tag keys, or retrieve all tag information used in your Flink fully managed workspace
ListTagResources.description_zh: 您可以调用ListTagResources查询资源标签。您可以通过标签的value查询key值，或者通过key值查询value，也可以获取您在flink全托管工作空间上使用的所有标签信息

ModifyAiServiceProtection.description_en: Modifies the shutdown protection setting for a Flink AI service
ModifyAiServiceProtection.description_zh: 修改Flink AI服务关闭保护

ModifyElasticResourceSpec.description_en: Modifies the maximum pay-as-you-go resource limit for a hybrid billing instance
ModifyElasticResourceSpec.description_zh: 对混合计费的实例，可修改按量部分最大可使用的上限资源

ModifyInstanceSpec.description_en: Scales up or scales down the resources of a workspace
ModifyInstanceSpec.description_zh: 调用本API可对工作空间进行扩容或缩容操作

ModifyInstanceVswitch.description_en: Modifies the vSwitches available to a Flink workspace
ModifyInstanceVswitch.description_zh: 修改Flink工作空间可使用的虚拟交换机

ModifyNamespaceSpecV2.description_en: Modifies the resource configurations of a project namespace in a pay-as-you-go, subscription, or hybrid billing workspace
ModifyNamespaceSpecV2.description_zh: 修改按量和包年包月、混合计费工作空间下项目空间的资源配置

ModifyPrepayInstanceSpec.description_en: Modifies the compute resource specifications of a subscription Realtime Compute for Apache Flink instance. If the new specifications are smaller than the current specifications, a scale-in operation is performed. If the new specifications are larger than the current specifications, a scale-out operation is performed
ModifyPrepayInstanceSpec.description_zh: 修改包年包月的flink全托管实例计算资源的规格大小，调整后规格小于当前使用规格将进行缩容操作，调整后规格大于当前使用规格将进行扩容操作

ModifyPrepayNamespaceSpec.description_en: Modifies the specifications of a namespace in a subscription instance
ModifyPrepayNamespaceSpec.description_zh: 修改包年包月实例下项目空间的规格

QueryConvertInstancePrice.description_en: Queries the price for converting a pay-as-you-go instance to a subscription instance
QueryConvertInstancePrice.description_zh: 您可以通过本API来查询按量付费实例转包年包月价格

QueryConvertPrepayInstancePrice.description_en: Queries the estimated refund amount after converting your Flink instance from subscription to pay-as-you-go. After the conversion, your usage is metered hourly and bills are generated accordingly
QueryConvertPrepayInstancePrice.description_zh: 调用本API可以查看您的Flink实例从包年包月模式转为按量付费模式后，预计退款的金额，转为按量付费后将按小时计量您的使用情况并产生账单

QueryCreateInstancePrice.description_en: Retrieves the price of a workspace for the current account
QueryCreateInstancePrice.description_zh: 获取本账号购买工作空间的价格

QueryModifyInstancePrice.description_en: Queries the price for upgrading or downgrading an instance
QueryModifyInstancePrice.description_zh: 您可以查询实例升降配时的价格

QueryRenewInstancePrice.description_en: Queries the renewal price of a subscription workspace
QueryRenewInstancePrice.description_zh: 您可以查询续费一个包年包月工作空间的价格

RenewInstance.description_en: Renews a subscription Realtime Compute for Apache Flink workspace
RenewInstance.description_zh: 续费一个包年包月flink全托管工作空间

TagResources.description_en: Call this API to add tags to resources
TagResources.description_zh: 您可以调用本API创建资源标签

UntagResources.description_zh: 您可以调用UntagResources删除资源标签
